design_principles: Match each screen to an existing backend resource or action.
Use one primary action per page and keep destructive actions isolated.
Surface read-only telemetry as a summary card before tables.
Mirror role hierarchy in navigation state and empty states.
Prefer dense layouts for admin tasks, but keep touch targets large enough for keyboard and mobile support.
